findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: swap_quote, prepare_signing, invoice_create, invoice_analysis_pay, destination_challenge, invoice_pay, payout_batch, check_access_challenge, check_access, check_buy_challenge, check_buy_proof · Private data: swap_quote, swap_build, double_quote, double_build, nn_quote, nn_build, prepare_signing, report_execution, swap_status, invoice_create, invoice_analysis_pay, invoice_report_analysis_payment, wallet_check, destination_challenge, destination_authorize, invoice_get, invoice_pay, payout_batch, payout_charge, payout_reuse, invoice_report_payment, check_info, check_access_challenge, check_access, check_buy_challenge, check_buy_proof, check_charge, check_report_payment, check_analyze, check_credits · Public sink: swap_build, nn_build, prepare_signing, invoice_create, invoice_analysis_pay, destination_challenge, invoice_pay, payout_batch, payout_charge, payout_reuse · Destructive: swap_build, double_build, nn_quote, prepare_signing, invoice_analysis_pay, wallet_check, destination_challenge, invoice_pay, payout_batch, payout_charge, check_analyze, check_credits.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
